name: B10-0093/2026 (PPE) – Case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is taking a position on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese researcher held in the Central African Republic. He was taken by the Wagner group in May 2024, says he was tortured, and was later sentenced to ten years of forced labour. The Parliament condemns this, calls for his release, and asks the European Union to consider sanctions on those responsible.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for his release and possible EU sanctions on those involved.
- **Who it affects:** Joseph Figueira Martin, the Central African Republic authorities, and Wagner group members.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the EU Council, Commission and other bodies. They decide whether to act.
